newsitem.title: USA: Skyline Corp sees improved Q4 vs Q3.
newsitem.headline: Skyline Corp sees improved Q4 vs Q3.

text.p: Skyline Corp said Monday it expects its fiscal 1997 fourth quarter ending in May to be an improvement over the third quarter.

"We anticipate improvement in the fourth quarter over the third quarter because we are entering our spring selling season, which, historically, is a much better period for both industries in which we operate," the manufactured home and recreational vehicle maker said in a news release.
Earlier Monday the company reported net income of $1.8 million, or $0.18 a share for the third quarter, compared to $3.1 million, or $0.30 a share a year ago.
